en.headline: Man arrested for drink-driving after car flips on Princess Margaret Road
en.dek: Police said a 48-year-old driver failed a breath test after his private car hit a barrier and overturned near Hung Hom on Wednesday night; he was not injured.
body: A 48-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of drink-driving after his private car hit a roadside barrier and overturned on Princess Margaret Road in Hung Hom on Wednesday night, police said.

Officers were called at about 10 p.m. after the car, travelling south towards Hung Hom, left the carriageway near the junction with Chi Man Street, close to the Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals. The vehicle came to rest on its side in the slow lane.
Police said the driver had an odour of alcohol and failed an initial breath test. He was not injured. He was detained for further inquiries.
The case was classified as drink-driving. Police reminded motorists not to drive after drinking.

zh.headline: 公主道私家車撞壤翻側 48歲司機涉酒駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方指車輛周三晚在紅磬公主道近治民街失控撞壤翻側，司機酒精呼氣測試不合格，沒有受傷。
body: 一名48歲男子涉嫌酒後駕駛被捕。警方表示，其私家車周三晚上在紅磬公主道撞向石壤後翻側。
晚上約10時，該車沿公主道往紅磬方向行駛，至近治民街交界、愛護動物協會對開懷疑失控撞壤，車身側臥慢線。
到場人員發現司機身上有酒氣，初步酒精呼氣測試不合格，他沒有受傷，現正被扣留調查。
案件列為酒後駕駛，警方提醒司機切勿酒後駕駛。
